newsitem.title: USA: Family Dollar stake cut by SC Fundamental.
newsitem.headline: Family Dollar stake cut by SC Fundamental.

text.p: A group including SC Fundamental Value Fund L.P. said Monday it reduced its stake in Family Dollar Stores Inc to 5.0 percent, or 2,859,400 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commision, the New York-based investment group said it sold a net of 544,600 shares of Family Dollar between October 11 and December 13 at prices ranging from $16.50 to $20.619 a share.
The group said it holds its stake in the Matthews N.C.,-based discount store chain for investment.
